scope: Static logic screen; not measured power or protocol compliance
interface: Existing3.3V open-drain externalI2C; existing prohibition on5V pull-ups retained
logic_spec_conditions: SN74AUP1G32 RevK -40..85C; manufacturer VOH/VOL cases at VCC3.0V; use as lower-supply drive screen for3.3V rail
AUP_Ioff_condition: VCC0V; DeltaIoff also specified over0..0.2V; VI/VO0..3.6V; -40..85C

local_off_leakage_calculation.remaining_paths: Direct MCU GPIO connection and external devices still require separate off-power review/test

firmware_requirements: Use existing PE3; no added MCU GPIO
Before USB suspend or unconfiguration: stop externalI2C peripheral, park GPIO analog/no-pull, then clear PE3
Keep USB wake path operational; reinitialize/recover externalI2C after configuration/resume
Keep PB0 STATUS_LED off during low-current stages; dedicated PWR LED remains hardware
not_qualified: ExternalI2C rise-time/cable-capacitance and mixed peripheral loads
GPIO direct pin injection with MCU unpowered
Non-rail input ICC and source transitions
Firmware implementation, USB current and suspend/recovery waveforms
